liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): Intro features Billy and Mickey entering the beat individually, with one on odd beats initially; Features a beautiful pre-last-verse solo with upbeat, skippy Garcia phrases [14][22]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Described as one of the coolest versions ever played by the band [19]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Pre-drums jam is cited as the best example of the band's potential at that moment [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-19.mtx.hansokolow.97024.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 158 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd90-03-19.prefm-sbd.sacks.1526.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 4.21/5 by 51 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound seemed to degrade at the end of Around And Around, though the rest is beautiful [23]
- **gd1990-03-19.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.86825.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 153 min [6]. Said about its sound: Muffled crowd and first nine seconds of Box of Rain due to accidental mic attenuator [6]
- **gd1990-03-19.149333.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 157 min [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended alone, leaving a friend to tape the radio broadcast during the show [16]
- Stems kicked in early during Deal, prompting the reviewer to nervously ask about it [16]
- This was the final Grateful Dead concert held at the Hartford Civic Center [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-19.mtx.hansokolow.97024.flac16**: transferred by matrix by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=1526 and AUD: shnid=94400 [1]. Also: Drums section is short because Healy's spacey drums are placed on the Space track [1]
- **gd90-03-19.prefm-sbd.sacks.1526.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Kirby Bell, Bob Fishman & Darrin Sacks; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Source is a pre-FM soundboard master reel transferred to DAT, CDR, and SHN [2]
- **gd1990-03-19.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.86825.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on stand 7-feet high, set up just behind the soundboard area:… [6]
- **gd1990-03-19.149333.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital Audience Recording by Ted Mattes Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & reMastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 25, 2020; source: From the Teddy Ballgame Archive - a reMaster of shnid 141914 Source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4 MK4 > DAT (Panasonic SV250) Location: Sec 2 Row p Seat 7 [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-19 Mon Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1250584291267/grateful-dead-1990-03-19-mon-hartford) [27]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-19 Mon Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1250584291267/grateful-dead-1990-03-19-mon-hartford) [28]
- Fan art by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring '90 Tour: Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT 3/19/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241652/30th-anniversary-of-the-grateful-deads-spring-90-tour-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-3-19-90/) [29]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 3/19/90 Civic Center, Hartford, …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26777648684/) [30]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26777648684/) [31]
